utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still spreading the word, and I’ll pass along the repair drive’s day and time tonight as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—once you’ve got the day and time, send it over and I’ll help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do—I’m still asking around, and I’ll send you the repair drive’s day and time tonight as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll get that list over to you tonight, and I’ll bring my toolbox and spare drill Saturday so we don’t duplicate anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot. Once I see the list, I can check what simple jobs I can take on and ask around a bit.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I’ll send it tonight, and if you hear who’s good for railings or plumbing, that’ll help us cover Maple Street cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli—if you can help me check what’s already on hand, I’ll keep the list focused on tarps, work gloves, tape, extension cords, and cleaning rags.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a clear list, Cleo. I’ll check what’s already on hand and then we can mark what still needs to be brought in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—once you’ve checked, let me know what’s missing and I’ll update the supply list, especially for tarps and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—if Cleo still needs coverage, your window between school runs sounds perfect; I should check with her since she’s got the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—if Cleo still needs someone, I can do a shift outside 7:30–8:30 and 2:30–3:30.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that helps a lot—I’ll check with Cleo and let her know you’re free between those school windows if she still needs coverage.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to check the sign-up sheet first, and then confirm with Leo whether the tools list and pickup times are still open before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That makes sense—just let me know what Leo says, and I’ll keep the sheet steady on my end.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli—I’ll check the sheet now and confirm with Leo about the tools and pickup times before I update anyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help pull people in for it, Dane—if Cleo can confirm the current needs, I can start spreading the word across a few different groups.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Jules—that helps a lot; once Cleo confirms, let’s point folks first at the busted bikes, then the loose fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—that gives me a clear way to steer people, and once Cleo confirms the list I’ll start reaching out across the different groups.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—I’m still out on errands, so please keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming along tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, before tonight I need specifics—what still needs fixing, who’s definitely covering the porch steps and shed patching, and whether Mara’s confirmed any of it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, Mina, so I don’t have those specifics yet—please check with Mara and keep me posted on what’s confirmed for the porch steps and shed patching tonight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m waiting on Gus’s tool list tonight before I ask folks to bring anything, because I really don’t want a mess with duplicate tools or people stuck waiting on timing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Makes sense—I’ve got the repair drive marked at the community room at Maple Court by the front entrance, so once Gus sends the timing and tool list, I can pass the exact details along cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot—once Gus texts the list, I’ll compare it against the sign-up so we don’t end up with overlap or a bunch of people waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Nell, can you confirm it’s definitely happening this weekend before we start lining up pickups?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can’t confirm the timing myself—I only heard bits from Mara, so I’d check with her before lining up pickups.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, then let’s hold off on pickups until Mara or Rosa confirms it’s definitely on for this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, Bo, it’s still on for this weekend—they’re just waiting on one last confirmation, and folks are rallying to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that tracks—once that last confirmation lands, we’ll start at Maple, hit the bikes first, then the fence, and keep moving so every house gets covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds well organized, Bo—I'll keep passing the word along, and Gus did say he can lend extra hands and a spare drill if Maple needs it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, we’ve got the repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—can you make it, and maybe spread the word to a couple neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I can make it from 10 to 2, and I’ll let a couple neighbors know today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Leo—I’ve got you down, and I really appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara—that helps a lot. Start in the community room at Maple Court by the front entrance, and I’ll keep tracking the list from here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, Rosa—I’m heading to the community room at Maple Court now and I’ll start with the bikes first, then the fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara—thank you. I’ll keep an eye on the list here, so just send me a quick update once the bikes are underway.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, Nell, just not during school drop-off or pickup—I'm clear between 8:30 and 2:30 if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s useful, thanks—what I’ve heard is they still need help with the porch steps and the shed patching, but I’m still waiting on a firmer update from Mara.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That window still works for me, so if Mara confirms they need someone, I can take a shift between 8:30 and 2:30.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — the repair drive is confirmed for Sunday at the community center now, so please pass along the updated time and place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps—I’ll pass along Sunday at the community center, but I still want to confirm the tool list and pickup timing so we don’t duplicate anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Pia — let’s double-check the tool list together, and pickup is still the usual window unless I send an update.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ira, can you confirm it’s definitely happening this weekend at Maple Court before we start counting on pickups?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can’t confirm that yet—I’m still out on errands and waiting on tonight’s update, so please don’t count on pickups until I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, then I’m treating it as unconfirmed until tonight’s update—please let me know as soon as you have a definite yes for this weekend at Maple Court.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re close—just waiting on that last confirmation, but it’s still looking like Saturday at ten by the Maple Street garden shed. If you can help spread the word or bring a hand, that’d steady things a bit.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ve been telling folks already, and I’ll keep spreading the word that it’s looking like Saturday at ten by the Maple Street garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Vik—that helps a lot. I’ll let you know as soon as that last confirmation comes through.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m set for Saturday from 9 to 1 with my drill, socket set, and extension cords—just tell me what still needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, Sam—if the sheet still shows tools and pickup covered, let’s start on the bikes first and then hit that loose garden fence; I might roll in a little late, but I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll start on the bikes when I get there and then move over to the fence, and I’ll keep things rolling till you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got us marked low on tarps and probably work gloves, and I still want to double-check the nails before the next pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good catch—I’ll confirm the weekend plan and pickup times today, and I’ll check tarps, gloves, and the nails count while I’m at it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—once you’ve got the counts, send them my way and I’ll update the supply list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — I’ve got it marked at the community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance, and I’m still passing that along while we track down the tarps and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many houses are actually signed up so far, and do we have enough volunteers lined up, or is that still unconfirmed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still only have the location pinned down for sure—the signup count and volunteer list haven’t been confirmed to me yet. If I hear an updated tally, I’ll pass it along tonight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the community shed at ten. I’ll bring my toolbox and whatever spare screws I can find, if I don’t misplace them again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good. Do you know if they’ve got a clear list of the small fixes yet, or are folks just bringing tools and figuring it out there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I don’t think I’ve seen a proper list—seems like folks are mostly just showing up and sorting it out there. I’ll still bring the toolbox and screws, just in case that helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still planning to text that tool list tonight, and I can bring my toolbox and spare drill on Saturday so we don’t duplicate anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—that helps a lot. Once your list comes through, I can pass along a clear ask to a few different groups so we don’t end up with a pile of the same tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll send it over tonight, and if anything’s still missing after that, I can probably round up a couple extra basics too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we’re still short on tarps and maybe work gloves, and maybe a couple more volunteers too—but Cleo would know for sure if that changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah—I’ll check with Cleo on tarps, gloves, and volunteer gaps, and if Dane’s still set on bikes first, I’ll start there once we’ve got the supplies lined up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right—I might be behind, but Cleo’s probably got the clean list if anything shifted since I heard.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it straightforward: once Quinn confirms the day and time, I’ll make a simple list of the repair jobs and then we can slot Faye in around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed, so go ahead and make the list, and we’ll fit Faye in around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street shed is clear enough for me. I’ll make a simple list of the repair jobs now, and then we can place Faye where she fits outside drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say what still needs doing, I want to confirm the sign-up count and whether Leo has already sorted the tools and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Skim me the count and I’ll match it to the house list; I just need to know if Leo’s locked the tools and pickup times yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t want to guess—let me check the sign-up sheet first, and I still need Leo to confirm whether the tools and pickup times are already locked in.
